_doc: Creature art prompts for tools/art/generate.py (specs/26 section 6, issue #116). Style is described in words only: never name an artist or a series.

abyss.name: Abyss expedition watercolour (specs/26 section 7)
abyss.prompt: Original creature illustration for a monster-raising game, single creature centred and fully in frame, three-quarter view, full body. Soft hand-painted watercolour with layered translucent washes and visible paper grain, a fine delicate sepia pencil line with light hatching in the shadows. Background: a vast, misty, vertical chasm deep underground with hanging roots, glowing bioluminescent flora and soft light falling from far above, fading into luminous haze. Rich, saturated colours with deep contrast and bright glowing accents; the creature is crisp, sharply lit and clearly separated from the misty background, never washed out. The creature is endearing and cute, but has exactly one subtly unsettling detail, as if sketched by an expedition researcher. No text, no letters, no signature, no frame, no border.

hunter.name: Hunter / system dark (specs/26 section 3)
hunter.prompt: Original creature illustration for a monster-raising game, single creature centred and fully in frame, three-quarter view, full body, dramatic low angle. Polished Korean action-webtoon rendering: crisp digital cel shading with two or three hard-edged tone steps per colour, thin dark linework, a strong rim light in electric blue or violet along one edge, and glowing eyes with a soft bloom. Background: a near-black navy void with faint vertical light streaks, drifting embers and dust, and a glowing rune circle on the ground like a dungeon gate. High contrast, saturated colours, a sense of power and menace even when the creature is cute. No text, no letters, no signature, no frame, no border.

slime.name: Coremote
slime.prompt: A round, translucent blue jelly creature (deep blue to sky blue) with a glossy highlight and two small dark eyes. A glowing golden nucleus floats inside the gel. Unsettling detail: the nucleus has a slit pupil like an eye, and a tiny fish skeleton drifts inside the gel.

drake.name: Bastion Drake
drake.prompt: A squat, heavy young dragon with a red-orange body, small cream horns and yellow eyes, covered in riveted grey steel forge plates like a siege tower. Fire glows orange through a ribbed, bellows-like chest. Unsettling detail: the plates are riveted straight into its flesh, with dark trickles under the rivets.

sprite.name: Mirage Moth
sprite.prompt: A small, luminous moth creature with large gold and cream wings, feathery antennae and a fuzzy cream body, hovering in a faint halo of glowing dust. The wings carry hypnotic eyespots, dark purple ringed with orange. Unsettling detail: the eyespots look like real eyes, with irises, lids and catchlights.

mandrake.name: Mandrake
mandrake.prompt: A small root creature shaped like a little person: a tan and brown gnarled root body, root legs and root arms flung up, a sprout of fresh green leaves on its head, half pulled out of the dark soil. Its mouth is wide open in a scream. Unsettling detail: the screaming mouth is lined with rings of tiny needle teeth.

shade_hound.name: Shade Hound
shade_hound.prompt: A dog made purely of shadow, deep purple-black with soft violet edges, in a real canine pose with a lean body and four jointed legs, its tail dissolving into drifting smoke. Bright acid-green eyes and small white fangs. Unsettling detail: a short row of tiny extra acid-green eyes along its cheek.

fountain_axolotl.name: Fountain Axolotl
fountain_axolotl.prompt: A pink-aqua axolotl whose six feathery gills are glowing little fountains, with a ring of water orbiting it; its claws and tail are water jets.

candlemane.name: Candlemane
candlemane.prompt: A majestic lion-like beast of living light and candle wax, ivory-white and pale gold. Its mane is a full ring of tall burning candle flames in white-gold and amber, and soft wax drips and pools down its shoulders and flanks where the flames touch, as if it is slowly burning itself to shine. A thin golden halo-wheel floats behind its head. Its eyes glow bright gold, and molten gold light seeps through cracks in its chest like a lantern. Proud, sacred and solemn, powerful, a light-element monster.

pyre_stag.name: Pyre Stag
pyre_stag.prompt: A gaunt, ash-grey stag creature that is slowly burning itself alive. Its antlers are a living funeral pyre: stacked charred branches wreathed in roaring orange-gold flame. Its hide is cracked like cooling charcoal, with molten ember light glowing through the cracks along its ribs, spine and legs; flakes of ash and sparks peel off its body and drift upward. Rusted iron penitent chains hang from its neck, with small blackened bells. Lean, long-legged and solemn, head held high; eyes are white-hot embers. Grimdark and mythic, a sacred beast that pays for its power with its own body.

keepshell_crab.name: Keepshell Crab
keepshell_crab.prompt: A stubby rust-orange hermit crab that wears a whole stone castle keep as its shell: crenellated towers, a portcullis gate over its face, coral and seaweed growing in the mortar. Its claws are wrapped in riveted gate-plates and raised to punch. Cute, glaring little castle.

iaido_mantis.name: Iaido Mantis
iaido_mantis.prompt: A cracked jade-and-orchid mantis with a torn wing, crouched in a quick-draw stance with one scythe in a leaf scabbard.

cuckling.name: Cuckling
cuckling.prompt: A plump, fluffy cuckoo chick, round as a ball and oddly large for its nest, with soot-black and deep violet down, a pale lavender belly, tiny stubby wings and oversized clawed orange feet gripping a nest of black thorny twigs. It wears the cracked top half of a white speckled eggshell like a little helmet tilted over one eye: the shell of an egg that was not its own. Its huge beak gapes wide open, begging, and the inside of its mouth glows bright magenta-violet. Large glossy round eyes with violet glints, adorable but greedy. On the ground beside the nest lies a small pale blue egg that has been pushed out. Cute, with something quietly wrong about it.

aegis_ram.name: Aegis Ram
aegis_ram.prompt: A white-and-gold bighorn ram braced inside a golden shield of light, hooves planted, three glowing pips charging on its curled horns. Noble, steadfast and mythic, a light-element monster.

apex_base: This is the creature's evolved apex form: the same species and recognisably the same individual as the reference image (same body shape, face and colours), but grander and more powerful, in exactly the same art style, lighting and kind of background as the reference. Do not add text. The change:
sprite: Redraw this exact creature as a small game battle sprite: the same design, pose and colours, full body, alone on a fully transparent background with no scenery, no ground, no rune circle and no shadow. Bold, even dark outline, simple two-tone cel shading, flat saturated colours, glowing parts kept bright, readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. No text.

living_ocean.name: Solaris Tide
living_ocean.prompt: the jelly has become a small living sea in teal and sea-green with its own weather: a tiny rain cloud above it and a curling wave-wall of water rising around it; the nucleus now glows white-gold.

abyssal_bloom.name: Abyssal Siphonophore
abyssal_bloom.prompt: the jelly has become a glowing deep-sea colony in deep violet and magenta: long translucent tendrils bloom out of it, pulsing pink light; many tiny nuclei drift inside like a string of pearls.

unbreakable_will.name: Aegis Wyrm
unbreakable_will.prompt: the forge plates have turned to gold-rimmed armour, cracked open to show a molten core; orange-gold light flares out of every crack as if blows were bouncing back.

inferno_sovereign.name: Surtr Drake
inferno_sovereign.prompt: the armour has gone dark iron and its fire has turned black and violet; it wears a crown of black flame with violet edges that no water could put out.

starlit_ascension.name: Comet Moth
starlit_ascension.prompt: the moth glows pale blue and white like a falling star, trailing a long comet tail of light and stardust behind it; its eyespots shine icy blue.

arcane_overflow.name: Gemini Moth
arcane_overflow.prompt: the moth is violet and lilac, and a translucent mirror twin of it hovers a half-beat behind, repeating its pose; pink sparks of magic arc between the two.

world_root.name: Worldroot Colossus
world_root.prompt: the root creature has grown into a colossal ancient tree-giant: towering and broad, its bark covered in thick green moss and glowing gold runes, a full wide canopy of bright green leaves and golden blossoms spreading above its head like a crown, massive roots splitting the ground and spreading far around it. Colour palette shifts from brown to deep moss green, leaf green and gold.

mandragora_scream.name: Mandragora Queen
mandragora_scream.prompt: the root creature is regal, pink and magenta, with a crown of blooming petals instead of leaves; its scream sends visible rings of pink sound out around it.

umbral_veil.name: Grave Shuck
umbral_veil.prompt: the shadow dog has become a towering spectral grave hound: its body pale, translucent ghostly silver-blue mist with a dark core, tattered like an old burial shroud trailing into fog, glowing cyan eyes, standing among leaning old gravestones on a misty hill under a cold moon. Colour palette shifts from black and violet to pale silver, ghost blue and cyan.

night_feast.name: Eclipse Hound
night_feast.prompt: the shadow dog is crimson and black, a golden eclipse ring burns like a halo behind its head, and all its eyes glow gold.

aquifer.name: Aquifer Olm
aquifer.prompt: the axolotl has transformed into an olm: a long, slender, serpent-like cave salamander, pale white and translucent like frosted glass with no pink at all, glowing aqua from inside, coiled in an S-curve through cracked dark bedrock with water seeping from every crack. Tiny legs, long body. Colour palette: white, pale cyan and aqua only.

six_fountains.name: Xolotl Wellspring
six_fountains.prompt: the axolotl has become a huge mythic river-dragon: a long, powerful dragon body with the axolotl's face, deep teal and turquoise scales with gold accents, its six gills now towering geysers shooting high, a carved stone fountain basin floating behind it like a halo, rain falling upward. Much larger and more majestic. Colour palette: deep teal, turquoise and gold.

martyrs_pyre.name: Martyr Pyrelion
martyrs_pyre.prompt: the same lion, but its fire has turned white-hot: the whole wax mane is now a tall roaring pyre of white and pale ice-blue flame, the candles burn white, the body is pale ivory wax streaked with blue-white light. Colour palette shifts from warm gold to white and pale blue.

hollow_sun.name: Hollow Sun Lion
hollow_sun.prompt: the same lion, darkened: its body is now charcoal-black wax with molten cracks, its halo is a huge black-cored sun ringed in white fire behind its head, and its chest is an open furnace glowing crimson-orange. Colour palette shifts from gold to black, crimson and white.

inverted_mercy.name: Cinder Saint
inverted_mercy.prompt: the stag has burnt down to a hollow blackened ribcage with a white-hot, blue-white fire burning inside it, a burning antler halo above its head, and its chains glowing white-hot. Colour palette shifts from orange to white and electric blue-white flame on charred black.

undying_pyre.name: Everpyre Hart
undying_pyre.prompt: a colossal hart of living flame with no hide left, its antler pyre risen into a crown-shaped bonfire, black bells ringing in the smoke.

unbreached_keep.name: Citadel Kingcrab
unbreached_keep.prompt: the keep grows into a walled citadel of towers and banners with a seawater moat; the claws become gatehouses, portcullises down.

siege_pincers.name: Siegebreaker Crab
siege_pincers.prompt: the castle shell has been rebuilt as a dark iron-and-timber siege tower on wheels, its claws replaced by heavy black iron battering rams with crab-claw heads, cracked enemy shields hung on its walls as trophies. Colour palette shifts from grey stone to black iron, dark wood and rust red.

still_hunt.name: Ghost Orchid Reaper
still_hunt.prompt: the jade fades to translucent white-and-violet like a ghost orchid, the torn wing a fan of petals; perfectly still, both scythes sheathed, petals frozen in the air.

severed_arts.name: Thousand-Petal Kensei
severed_arts.prompt: a tall mantis sword saint with both scythes drawn, the wing regrown as a cloak of orchid petals, cut paper talismans pinned along its scabbard.

usurper_cuckoo.name: Usurper Cuckoo
usurper_cuckoo.prompt: a grown cuckoo, larger than any host, wearing a crown of broken eggshell.

clutch_empress.name: Clutch Empress
clutch_empress.prompt: the chick has grown into a tall, elegant, regal brood-mother cuckoo empress: sleek glossy plumage in deep violet and black with a soft lavender chest, a long flowing train of tail feathers like a royal gown, and a small cracked-eggshell tiara. She sits on a grand throne-like nest of woven thorny branches, gently sheltering just three large pale-blue speckled eggs under one wing. Calm, proud, motherly expression. Smooth feathers with no clusters, no bumps, no holes, no eggs attached to her body. Colour palette adds soft lavender and warm gold accents to the violet.

headlong_oath.name: Aries Vanguard
headlong_oath.prompt: the ram rears up on its hind legs mid-charge, pushing the golden shield ahead of it like a battering wall, its horns sheathed in heavy gold plate, five pips burning along them, three gold and two cracked glowing crimson; crimson light bleeds through cracks in the shield. Colour palette shifts to gold and deep crimson.

thunderhoof.name: Chrysomallos
thunderhoof.prompt: the winged ram of myth: fleece of beaten gold, sun-disc horns, the shield become wide golden wings, three pips orbiting like small suns.
